description: This file defines the PlotArea class, which represents the drawable area for charts within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes properties for formatting (line and fill), padding, cloning, serialization, and internal value management.

classes.name: PlotArea
classes.description: Represents the area where the chart is drawn, providing formatting, padding, cloning, and serialization functionalities.

classes.name: PlotArea.PlotAreaValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for PlotArea's formatting and padding.

methods.name: PlotArea()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the PlotArea with default values.

methods.name: PlotArea(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PlotArea with a specified parent object.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of this PlotArea instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy()
methods.description: Performs the deep copy of the object, including cloning and assigning format properties.
